name: live-row-read-returns-mount-material
description: The success half of the invariant, on the simplest path: the render is still live and the caller owns it. The result's contents must declare a delivery channel — a component URL, a live channel carrying BOTH an endpoint and a token, or a server-emitted system card. Graded on the projected render meta, never on markup: what the shell looks like is a server's own presentation concern.
